question: How does the freedom of consciousness account for what appears?
premises: As it makes things appear, so they truly appear.
It contains all forms within itself, and this is determined.
inference: Because free consciousness manifests appearances according to its own nature, those appearances are real as its self-expression.
plain_english: For this free consciousness makes things shine forth just as it wills, and so they truly appear; it contains all forms within itself, and this is firmly established.
